why: The chart evidence behind every song added on 9 September, so the 88 Wikipedia pages never have to be fetched again. Keyed by song id, the same id used in musical-library.json. year_end is the Kent and ARIA year-end singles charts, number_one is the Australian number-one singles pages, peaks come from the ARIA top ten pages for 2019 to 2024, hottest100 is the four triple j all time countdowns. Sources are listed in song-charts-2026-09-09.md.
